lyrics: "In the councils of government,
we must guard against the acquisition of
unwarranted influence,
whether sought or unsought, by the
military-industrial complex.
The potential for the disastrous rise
of misplaced power exists
and will persist."
A general retires on a Tuesday noon
By Friday morning he's singing a new tune
In a boardroom with a window and a view
Selling weapons for the red, white, and blue
A congressman trades a vote for a new jet line
Built in his district, everything is fine
The iron triangle, a covenant they keep
While the rest of the country is talking in its
sleep
And the war machine keeps turning,
it's the only gear we know
Fear is the product, watch the profits
grow
Peace is a liability,
a threat to the bottom line
This ain't a nation, it's a corporate design
With unwarranted influence
Find a monster hiding underneath the bed
Put his angry face on the screen above your head
Exaggerate the threat, inflate the coming dread
Until we're begging for the very words you said
A satellite image, a shadow in the sand
Is a billion-dollar contract and a shaking of the hand
A far-off skirmish in a forgotten place
Is a market opportunity you cannot erase
And the war machine keeps turning,
it's the only gear we know
Fear is the product, watch the profits
grow
Peace is a liability,
a threat to the bottom line
This ain't a nation, it's a corporate design
With unwarranted influence
Your kid's school is crumbling,
the library books are tore
But there's always money for another little
war
The bridges are all rusting,
the water's full of lead
But the shareholders are happy and
the beast is getting fed
".The potential for the disastrous
rise."
".of misplaced power
exists."
".and will persist."
".exists and will persist."
